crossRefs.note: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

translations.web: The young lady was very beautiful; and she cherished the king, and served him; but the king didn’t know her intimately.
translations.bsb: The girl was unsurpassed in beauty; she cared for the king and served him, but he had no relations with her.
translations.kjv: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
translations.asv: And the damsel was very fair; and she cherished the king, and ministered to him; but the king knew her not.
